name: Big-LaMa (michaelgold safetensors)
usage: Pixel-exact object removal with a mask, no prompt

sources.note: 0.20 GB, converted from Sanster's TorchScript .pt, generator weights only

licence.note: Upstream LaMa is Apache 2.0; both allowed, relabel unexplained

runtimes.value: Spandrel (MIT) loads LaMa; comfyui-inpaint-nodes (GPL-3.0), chaiNNer; key compatibility untested

provenance.value: weak: converted from a third-party TorchScript file (Sanster/models), not from the official checkpoint; generator weights only; no hash, no validation; the card's code example points to another repository name

web.verdict: LaMa is still the lightweight reference; nothing on this conversion
web.summary: LaMa is the go-to lightweight inpainting model but a few years old. Newer Moebius was judged worse in practice.
web.scope: Conversion 07.2025 (3–12 months). Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, GitHub issues; Reddit blocked.

comments.text: LaMa is still the go-to lightweight inpainting model for anime and manga, but it is several years old.
